## Activity

During June 2025, North City Eye Clinic completed 551 captures. This activity represents the imaging workload recorded for the month. The available capture total provides the basis for the subsequent image-quality review and grading process. No change to the reported activity is noted.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 13 were ungradable. This produced an ungradable rate of 2.4 per cent. The result should be monitored through routine quality assurance, with attention given to image acquisition and any recurring causes of images being unsuitable for assessment. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 142 referable results. The median lag from photograph to grade was 2 days. This indicates the typical interval between image capture and completion of grading during June 2025. The activity, image-quality, and grading figures should continue to be reviewed as part of routine site operations at North City Eye Clinic.
